# shelfie

> The shelfie HTTP API.

Every endpoint below links to its reference page as Markdown. The OpenAPI document is at `/openapi.json` and the interactive reference at `/docs`. Errors are `application/problem+json` with a stable `code`.

## Authentication

- `bearer` (bearer): Session token from POST /v1/auth/login with "transport": "bearer", or an API key (gbk_…) from POST /v1/auth/api-keys. Browsers use the session cookie that login sets instead.

## Books

- [List your books](/docs/books/books-get-v1-books.md): `GET /v1/books`
- [Add a book to your shelf](/docs/books/books-post-v1-books.md): `POST /v1/books`
- [Get a book](/docs/books/books-get-v1-books-by-id.md): `GET /v1/books/{id}`
- [Change a book](/docs/books/books-patch-v1-books-by-id.md): `PATCH /v1/books/{id}`
- [Remove a book](/docs/books/books-delete-v1-books-by-id.md): `DELETE /v1/books/{id}`

## System

- [Build information](/docs/system/get-version.md): `GET /version`

## Optional

- [OpenAPI document](/openapi.json): every endpoint, parameter and schema
- [API reference overview](/docs.md)
